subject: website
name: Strudel on Swarm
summary: An unofficial Strudel live-coding REPL hosted on Swarm. Its source is public: a fork (AGPL-3.0) in Cafe137/strudel-web3, which another repository names as the source of app.livecoding.eth. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it fetches sample-bank lists from the strudel.b-cdn.net CDN.

connections.name: Sample-bank lists (strudel.b-cdn.net)
connections.note: Four JSON fetches when the page opens; samples are fetched from other hosts while patterns play.
